verdict.rationale: Terraform's only first-party AI capability is an official MCP server. It gives an external AI model real-time access to provider docs, modules and policies from the registry, so the AI can generate more accurate configurations from natural-language requests. The product itself has no natural-language interface: the core workflow is HCL files plus CLI commands like plan and apply, and the MCP server is documented only for docs and registry lookup, not for running Terraform operations. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documented NL-driven execution of plan/apply/state operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL operation.
